title: st edit hands back the path to a generated view and the next render destroys the edit, where the published tag refused
body:
**REWRITTEN TWICE ON 2026-08-31 BY ITS AUTHOR, AND THE SECOND SUBJECT IS ALSO NOT THE FIRST ONE.** Both wrong versions are DELETED rather than left under a banner. **THE TITLE IS STILL THE FIRST VERSION'S AND IS FALSE** -- no verb writes an issue title (`0151`), so the title cannot be brought in line with this body and `intent issues list` shows only titles.

**What version one got wrong.** It read `st edit <ST> info` returning a path as an unguarded regression, on the ground that the sibling `acceptance` still refuses. That invented a two-way partition where the code has three: `project.rs:1568` classifies the thread cover as `OpenRoundTrip` over a closed allow-list -- `views.rs:463`, `["Objective", "Context"]` -- beside `Open` and `Refuse`. **hv ruled the cover open on 2026-08-29, first-hand, after driving the refusal**, because the refusal was right about the file and wrong about the operator: its remedy said author it with `intent st`, and no `intent st` verb writes `objective` or `context` (`0185`). `acceptance` still refuses because `intent ac` and `intent at` genuinely author it. **The asymmetry is the ruling, not a gap.** `180fb4a3` is not an ancestor of `80d8b2ca`, so the keg's refusal is the old behaviour.

**What version two got wrong, which is the more useful failure.** It claimed *the cover is editable, the read-back is written, and no verb an operator can run connects them*, listing `sync --to-store` as reading the canon extract rather than `info.md`. **`sync --to-store` DOES carry the read-back.** `render.rs:1047` -> `Facade::sync_from_disk` -> `facade.rs:3137` `ingest::resync` -> `resync_inner` -> `carry_info_round_trip` -> assigns `thread.objective` / `thread.context` -> `store.rebuild`. The "reads the canon extract" line is the verb's own stdout describing the RESTORE half, while the carry happens in the same call.

**TWO INSTRUMENT ERRORS PRODUCED THAT, NOT TWO REASONING ERRORS, AND THEY ARE WORTH MORE THAN THE FIX.** First, **a drive on a FRESH project cannot exhibit the carry at all**: `resync_inner` builds `touched` as `FileState::Changed` AND present in the PREVIOUS index, so an unindexed estate has an empty baseline by construction and the carry is a designed no-op. Second, **the obvious check is `intent st show <id>`, and `st show` prints id, title, status and created -- and nothing else.** No Objective, no Context. **So a correct drive reports the edit missing while the database already holds it.** One sqlite query was the tell. cc found both, vc drove it independently, and I drove it a third time before rewriting this.

=== THE DEFECT THAT IS ACTUALLY THERE ===

**Text appended AFTER the trailing `_Generated by Intent v...` banner is accepted by `sync --to-store` at rc=0, carried nowhere, and reported by nothing that verb says.** `authored_regions` (`views.rs:639`) truncates the text at `rfind("\n\n---\n\n_Generated by Intent v")`, so post-banner text lands in neither `want` nor `got`; the structural guard at `views.rs:559` -- which exists precisely to catch an added section -- compares two lists that agree, finds nothing, and the next projection rewrites the file without the text.

Driven on `553ac304` and on the published keg `80d8b2ca`, identically:

    $ printf '\n## Hand Added\n\nTEXT\n' >> intent/st/ST0001/info.md
    $ intent sync --to-store
    ok: store rewritten from the canon extract, 2 thread(s)          [rc=0]
    $ intent sync --to-disk && grep -c TEXT intent/st/ST0001/info.md
    0

**`>>` is how a script appends, which makes this likely rather than exotic.**

**THE GUARD IS SOUND AND THIS IS ONE HOLE IN IT, NOT A MISSING MECHANISM.** The same section inserted BEFORE the banner refuses correctly:

    error: could not read the committed canon
      caused by: residue: intent/st/ST0001/info.md -- view-skew -- ## Hand Added Before (added by hand)
        was edited by hand and does not round-trip -- only `## Objective` and `## Context` are read back,
        so move the text into one of those or discard it                                        [rc=1]

It names the offending section, names the two carried sections, gives a copy-it-out-first remedy, and leaves the file intact.

=== SEVERITY, AND THE HALF THAT IS NOT SILENT ===

**`intent doctor` DOES catch the post-banner case, on BOTH builds** -- `view-skew -- generated view differs from the model (767 bytes on disk, 733 rendered)`, rc=1. So the estate is not blind to it and the loss is not undetectable. **What is silent is the VERB**: `sync --to-store` is the command an operator runs to make an edit land, and on this input it reports success, carries nothing, and says nothing. A different instrument catching it later is not the same as the verb not lying.

**REACHABLE ON THE PUBLISHED TAG.** Driven on `80d8b2ca`: identical rc=0 acceptance, identical loss, identical `doctor` finding. This is not a `main`-only regression.

=== PLACEMENT, IF IT IS BUILT ===

**The refusal goes in `info_read_back`, not in `authored_regions`** (cc's placement, vc agrees). A function that both truncates and refuses is two jobs in one home.

**SCOPE IS hv's AND THIS ROW DOES NOT PRE-EMPT IT.** vc is carrying a recommendation to fix before the tag on `IN-AG-NO-SILENT-001` grounds. Recorded here as measured, not as ruled.
